_comment: CA1 network, time unit ms. w_*, I_base_*, tau_gaba come from scripts/search_network.py (random search, criteria fixed in advance, see outputs/network_search.json): of 344 evaluated candidates, 4 passed the control-state criteria and 1 also passed the orexin-up criterion; that one is used. eta_E, eta_I, p_conn, tau_ampa, sigma_noise, heterogeneity were fixed beforehand. The location of the transition in I_O is an output, not a fit target.
_bcm: BCM threshold theta_M = theta0 * <(f_i/f_target)^2>, f_target = f_t0 * I_O. f_t0 = theta0 = rms pyramidal rate of the control epoch, so that theta_M(control) equals the typical control rate (the BCM fixed point). Alternative sign: f_target = f_t0 / I_O.
_eta: eta_E = net gain of OX1R-Gq signalling on pyramidal neurons (free parameter, mapped in Fig. S1); eta_I = 0 (simplifying assumption).
_A: A(t) scales E->E synapses only (dendritic atrophy of pyramidal cells removes excitatory inputs onto their dendrites). 'all' = scale every synapse (negative control, Supplement).
